features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion

features.quote: The gripper (10) has a low pressure connection (14), and a flexible suction body (20) with a sealing lip (22) that limits a suction area (26) at a side turned away from a workpiece (32) of an electric bulb.
features.note: The reference discloses a flexible suction body with a sealing lip that limits a suction area, which is analogous to a seal extending around a carrier plate. However, it does not explicitly mention a rigid 'carrier plate' as part of the suction plate, only a 'suction body'.
